subject: world_language
concept: Completing a full independent capstone project from proposal through final presentation and reflection, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content, synthesizing the full K-12 world languages sequence — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student tracks their capstone through proposal/research/production/revision/presentation/reflection stages
exercise.abstract: Student completes an independent capstone project: an original proposal, authentic research, a near-native core component, careful revision, a prepared presentation, and a genuine growth reflection

assessment.mastery_threshold: capstone demonstrates all stages at a near-native (C2) level, cohering into one complete, polished project
misconception_flags: completes individual stages competently but the final project doesn't cohere into one unified demonstration of mastery

interest_binding: full capstone project generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
